title: Spec: tiered deadline multipliers in spec/appendix-bufferbloat.md
description: Add section to appendix-bufferbloat.md defining deadline multipliers per node class. leaf/router: 1x (SOS 2s, routing 5-10s, urgent 30s, normal 60s, bulk 120s). relay: 5x (SOS 10s, routing 25-50s, urgent 150s, normal 300s, bulk 600s). gateway: 10x (SOS 20s, routing 50-100s, urgent 300s, normal 600s, bulk 1200s). Explain: multiplier applies to forward buffer deadlines only, not locally-originated traffic (local always uses 1x). Verify: markdown renders.
